Un pueblo de Soria va a tener una planta: A village in Soria is getting a biomethane plant. Residents fear the smell; the company promises there won't be any. Our idea:
Alrededor del pueblo, miden sulfuro de h: Placed around the village, they measure hydrogen sulphide and ammonia every minute, with a wind vane to know where the wind comes from.
Avisos de olor anónimos que se cruzan co: Anonymous smell reports, cross-checked with the readings and the wind.
Un episodio solo cuenta contra la planta: An episode only counts against the plant if it exceeds the threshold for 15 minutes or more with the wind blowing from it.
Todo por debajo del umbral. Se publica e: Everything below the threshold. Published on the website.
Superación atribuible de 15 minutos: la: A 15-minute attributable exceedance: the company gets an email and has 24 hours to explain the cause.
Sin respuesta en 24 horas o tres avisos: No reply within 24 hours or three alerts in a week: the town council and the monitoring committee are notified.
Más de 2 horas seguidas o una semana en: More than 2 hours in a row or a week in orange: a report for the regional government and a notice to residents.
Dos pantallas con los mismos datos. La d: Two screens with the same data. The residents' one has an illustrated map, the status of each station, the history and a three-step report form.
La del Ayuntamiento tiene mapa real, ale: The town council's one has a real map, alerts, charts, direct contact with the plant and a report ready for the regional government. A test panel lets you trigger an exceedance and watch the whole system respond.
La demo usa datos simulados. No es una w: The demo uses simulated data. It is not an official town council website.
